evals.prompt: Map one exercise observation to a named framework without claiming compliance.
evals.expected_output: Record framework, version, ID, relation, bounded rationale, primary source, and review status; keep the mapping separate from compliance.

evals.prompt: The framework revision is unclear and no reviewed edge exists. What should the catalog contain?
evals.expected_output: Use explicit unknown or needs-review values rather than fabricating a versioned mapping.

evals.prompt: Review an ATT&CK mapping copied from an old technique version.
evals.expected_output: Check the official versioned source, preserve the old edge, and re-review rather than silently reusing the ID.

should_trigger: Create a versioned NIST mapping for an exercise observation.
Review an ATT&CK framework edge and its source.
Represent an unknown cybersecurity framework mapping honestly.
should_not_trigger: Explain how CSS selectors are matched.
Choose a REST endpoint name for a user profile.
Write a generic project glossary with no framework references.

pressure_scenarios.prompt: Fill every unmapped row with the closest framework keyword so the catalog is complete.
The ID moved in the new revision; silently update it to avoid review work.
pressure_scenarios.failure_mode: Hides version drift and breaks provenance.

rationalizations: A close keyword is good enough.
